name: assign_frame_load
author: hprebar
title: Assign load to frame objects
description: Assigns a distributed load (kN/m) or a point load (kN at relative position 0–1) to frame objects under a load pattern. Direction 1–3 local, 4–11 global (default 10 = Gravity / -Z global). Writes the model: the bridge saves it and takes a .SDB snapshot first.

frameNames.description: Unique names of the target frames

valueKNperM.description: Distributed load magnitude in kN/m (required if loadType='distributed')

valueKN.description: Point load magnitude in kN (required if loadType='point')

relativePosition.description: Position along the frame as a fraction 0–1 (point loads only)

direction.description: 1–3 local axes, 4–6 global X/Y/Z, 7–9 projected, 10 gravity (-Z), 11 projected gravity

replace.description: Replace existing loads on this pattern (false to add)
